title: 晶圓廠微污染控制
summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解來源、傳輸與缺陷地圖，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore sources, transport and defect maps through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 污染源與路徑
stages.description: 在「污染源與路徑」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for sources and pathways, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 建立污染源地圖
steps.objective: 完成「建立污染源地圖」的因果圖，把來源、傳輸與缺陷地圖中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for map contamination sources, connecting relevant limits in sources, transport and defect maps to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：建立污染源地圖。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：人員、設備、氣體、液體與載具都是可能來源。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Map contamination sources. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: People, tools, gases, liquids and carriers are possible sources. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「人員、設備、氣體、液體與載具都是可能來源。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: People, tools, gases, liquids and carriers are possible sources. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：粒子數低就證明金屬離子濃度低。 應回到「建立污染源地圖」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Low particle counts prove low metal-ion concentration. Revisit assumptions and sampling for map contamination sources and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「建立污染源地圖」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for map contamination sources: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 建立污染源地圖的原理
knowledge.text: 人員、設備、氣體、液體與載具都是可能來源。
knowledge.textEn: People, tools, gases, liquids and carriers are possible sources.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 污染控制是來源、傳輸、表面沉積與器件敏感度的串聯問題；控制來源並不自動證明所有傳輸路徑已封閉。
knowledge.textEn: Contamination links sources, transport, deposition and device sensitivity; source control does not prove all transport paths are closed.

quiz.question: 評估「建立污染源地圖」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating map contamination sources?
options: 人員、設備、氣體、液體與載具都是可能來源。
粒子數低就證明金屬離子濃度低。
未檢出代表污染濃度精確為零。
optionsEn: People, tools, gases, liquids and carriers are possible sources.
Low particle counts prove low metal-ion concentration.
quiz.explanation: 人員、設備、氣體、液體與載具都是可能來源。 污染控制是來源、傳輸、表面沉積與器件敏感度的串聯問題；控制來源並不自動證明所有傳輸路徑已封閉。
quiz.explanationEn: People, tools, gases, liquids and carriers are possible sources. Contamination links sources, transport, deposition and device sensitivity; source control does not prove all transport paths are closed.

steps.title: 尺寸與危害
steps.objective: 完成「尺寸與危害」的對照表，把來源、傳輸與缺陷地圖中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a controlled comparison for separate size and hazard, connecting relevant limits in sources, transport and defect maps to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：尺寸與危害。建立兩個只改一項條件的假想案例；分開記錄可觀察差異與推測原因；說明如何用本步原理區分兩者。判讀依據：相同尺寸的不同污染物未必有相同電性影響。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate size and hazard. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: Equal-sized contaminants can have different electrical effects. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「相同尺寸的不同污染物未必有相同電性影響。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Equal-sized contaminants can have different electrical effects. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：粒子數低就證明金屬離子濃度低。 應回到「尺寸與危害」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Low particle counts prove low metal-ion concentration. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate size and hazard and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「尺寸與危害」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for separate size and hazard: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

steps.title: 粒子與分子
steps.objective: 完成「粒子與分子」的敏感度草圖，把來源、傳輸與缺陷地圖中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a sensitivity sketch for distinguish particles and molecules, connecting relevant limits in sources, transport and defect maps to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：粒子與分子。選出本步的一項輸入及一項輸出；以自訂低、中、高三點畫趨勢；逐點標註假設，並寫出趨勢可能失效的條件。判讀依據：粒子過濾不能自動證明分子污染受控。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Distinguish particles and molecules. Select one input and output for this step; sketch a hypothetical low/mid/high trend; label assumptions and state when the trend may fail. Interpretation: Particle filtration does not establish molecular-contamination control. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「粒子過濾不能自動證明分子污染受控。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.check: 交付「粒子與分子」敏感度草圖：圖須有變數、單位或無因次定義、三個假設點及適用範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit the sensitivity sketch for distinguish particles and molecules: Include variables, units or dimensionless definitions, three hypothetical points and validity limits.

steps.title: 暴露劑量
steps.objective: 完成「暴露劑量」的故障判別表，把來源、傳輸與缺陷地圖中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a fault-discrimination table for estimate contamination exposure, connecting relevant limits in sources, transport and defect maps to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：暴露劑量。假設本步預期結果未出現；提出兩個不同機制；為各機制選一個能支持或否定的觀察，避免只重複同一量測。判讀依據：表面負荷同時取決於濃度與暴露時間。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。 自訂暴露模型：先假設沉積通量與濃度成正比。案例甲濃度 2、時間 3，案例乙濃度 1、時間 8；比較相對暴露，再列使此線性模型失效的吸附飽和情況。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Estimate contamination exposure. Assume the expected result fails; propose two distinct mechanisms; choose an observation that supports or rejects each rather than repeating one measurement. Interpretation: Surface burden depends on concentration and exposure duration. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs. Hypothetical exposure model: deposition flux is proportional to concentration. Compare relative exposures for concentration/time pairs (2,3) and (1,8), then state how adsorption saturation could invalidate linearity.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「表面負荷同時取決於濃度與暴露時間。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Surface burden depends on concentration and exposure duration. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：粒子數低就證明金屬離子濃度低。 應回到「暴露劑量」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Low particle counts prove low metal-ion concentration. Revisit assumptions and sampling for estimate contamination exposure and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「暴露劑量」故障判別表：至少列出兩個假說、各自的辨別證據及先檢查順序。 同時交付算例的中間步驟或比較圖，並標示假設與模型限制。
steps.checkEn: Submit the fault-discrimination table for estimate contamination exposure: List two hypotheses, discriminating evidence for each and a check order. Also submit intermediate calculations or comparison diagrams with assumptions and model limits.

steps.title: 沉積與再懸浮
steps.objective: 完成「沉積與再懸浮」的量測規劃，把來源、傳輸與缺陷地圖中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a measurement plan for trace deposition and resuspension, connecting relevant limits in sources, transport and defect maps to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：沉積與再懸浮。針對本步定義待測量及採樣位置；列出解析度、背景與重複性；設計一個見證或空白，並說明檢出限如何限制結論。判讀依據：清潔表面的擾動可能重新釋出粒子。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Trace deposition and resuspension. Define the measurand and sampling locations; list resolution, background and repeatability; design a witness or blank and explain detection-limit constraints. Interpretation: Disturbing a surface can resuspend deposited particles. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「清潔表面的擾動可能重新釋出粒子。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.check: 交付「沉積與再懸浮」量測規劃：提供採樣座標、量測單位、對照與不確定度來源。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan for trace deposition and resuspension: Provide sampling coordinates, units, controls and uncertainty sources.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：監控片安排。整合本步及本階段先前證據；提出兩項彼此不同的接受條件；再列一個會讓你暫緩放行的結果及下一個確認動作。判讀依據：監控片需要與實際搬運歷程一致。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Choose monitoring wafers. Combine this step with earlier stage evidence; propose two independent acceptance criteria; name one hold condition and the next confirming action. Interpretation: Monitor wafers need representative handling histories. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「監控片需要與實際搬運歷程一致。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.checkEn: Submit the engineering acceptance sheet for choose monitoring wafers: The sheet needs the principle, two evidence items, open questions and module handoff.
